app.about_body:
It is a specific value of sustainable development performance, with which the evolution of a unit of analysis over time can be compared. There is a global index, which refers to the average performance value of the set of dimensions that have been taken into account. Similarly, specific indices are obtained for each dimension, determining the performance of each of them.


The SDI varies between zero and one, with the value of one being the best attainable situation and zero otherwise.
app.about_body2:
• Represent in a didactic way a given situation, by means of an approximate index of development. This index symbolizes the state of sustainability and allows a first approach to the performance of a given unit of analysis.


• Visualize the general development of the unit of analysis and each of the individual dimensions at a given time. This image will determine the existence or lack of balance between dimensions such as


N.B: It is a series of positive and negative statements to which the user has to answer yes or no. Numerically the yes will be a one and not a zero and this step is exclusive.

app.subTitle_preMain: SDI (Sustainable Development Index) is a specific value used to measure sustainable development of a specific area. Internationally, a SDI system is used for countries and it is not as precise, not only because it does not consider politics as one dimension, but also because it uses only 10 factors for each of the three dimensions they use: the environmental, social and economic dimension. . On the other hand, this SDI that the app allows to calculate is for cities, departments or provinces, which is why it has more factors to provide more precision. The result is approximate.
app.userGuide_end: Thank you for using the application!
app.userGuide_text: This app is specifically created to calculate the Sustainable Development Index for areas other than large areas or countries. Therefore, a lot of factors and up to 4 dimensions are considered. Furthermore, this also makes the end result almost accurate. It should be remembered that the result of the app is approximate and indicative. It is offline and free for anyone. For a good use of the app, the following instructions must be followed:
app.userGuide_text1: 1- This app is a tool, first of its kind, to carry out the calculation of the Sustainable Development Index considering many very precise factors. It will serve to say how sustainably developed an area is and what measures should be taken to improve it.
app.userGuide_text2: 2- The weighted average formula is used to perform this calculation. This makes each factor have a weight in the result. The statements that represent negative factors, such as: crime, have negative weights, -15%. If yes, this percentage will have a negative weight, automatically reducing the result.
app.userGuide_text3: 3- The use must be professional in the sense that only professionals (employees of organizations or officials working for a specific area) and official institutions (municipality, head of province, university and state) must use the app. This is so that there are official and reliable results for the areas for which the SDI would be calculated. It is a way to make the results more objective.
app.userGuide_text4: 4- It is practically a structured interview with statements that only accept YES-NO answers. So this interview should be carried out with people who know the selected area well. This to avoid subjectivity in the answers.
app.userGuide_text5: 5- You should only answer by 0 and 1, which correspond respectively to NO and YES. Always click SAVE after the result of a dimension is returned. You cannot enter any value other than 0 or 1.
app.userGuide_text6: 6- Every time you finish filling a subsection, it appears in Green, this is so that you do not return by mistake to one that you had already answered.
app.userGuide_text7: 7- The suggestions that come out depending on the result range are approximate. That is, they may not correspond to such a zone as a solution to specific problems. They can serve as a reference or orientation to find solutions to problems that are specific to areas.
app.userGuide_text8: 8- It is a Graduation Project carried out by the student Moïse Standley (2020), candidate for a Bachelor of Agricultural Sciences from EARTH University, Costa Rica. It is advised by the MSc. Victor Hugo Morales Peña, Professor and consultant in tropical forestry and remote sensing with drones at EATH University.
app.userGuide_text9: 9- A responsible use of the application is recommended.
